summary: Code review of HomeView.tsx fix for 'empty middle tile in incomplete last row' of Explore Services grid in the Expo Customer App (/app/Customer). Running Expo web was not feasible in this env; verification performed via static code/math review as per request's fallback.
critical_code_review_comments: Math verified: width 31.5% x 3 + marginRight 2.75% x 2 = 94.5 + 5.5 = 100% exactly. No wrap onto a 4th column.

Every 3rd tile (i % 3 === 2) sets marginRight: 0 -> full rows end flush at the right edge; incomplete last row (indices 3,4 when 5 categories) uses marginRight 2.75% so items sit left-aligned with a single 2.75% gap between them. No empty middle slot. Original bug (justifyContent: space-between pushing last 2 items to edges) is resolved.
testIDs preserved: home-categories (container), cat-<slug> (each tile). No regressions to selectors.
aspectRatio: 1 on image box retained; marginBottom: 14 preserves vertical rhythm between rows.
Note: slice(0,12) caps at 12 categories; with the new margin pattern, 10/11-category edge cases also render correctly (last row left-aligned).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Only HomeView.tsx grid logic was reviewed (lines 118-128). Fix uses flex-start + conditional marginRight instead of space-between. Expo web/device run was not performed; recommend a quick manual run on device/simulator to visually confirm with 5 categories.
rca of the issue: Previous code used flexWrap + justifyContent: 'space-between' with 31.5% tiles. When the last row contained fewer than 3 items, space-between distributed them to the row's extremes, leaving a visible gap in the middle (row 2: Appliance Repair --- gap --- Carpentry). Fix: justifyContent 'flex-start' plus marginRight 2.75% on all tiles except every 3rd (i%3===2) which gets 0. 3*31.5 + 2*2.75 = 100%, so full rows fit perfectly and incomplete rows stay left-aligned without any middle gap.
